component.name: Pocket Sense
component.summary: Private, offline money tracker in English and Arabic, in 69 currencies

description.p: Pocket Sense tracks your income, spending, accounts, budgets, bills, loans and savings circles without signing up and without the internet, in any of 69 currencies. Everything stays in an encrypted database on your computer. It leaves only as an encrypted backup, or, if you turn on sync, encrypted to your own paired devices on your Wi-Fi.

ul.li: No sign-in, no servers, no ads, no analytics. The app uses the network only to sync with your own devices on your local network, and only if you turn that on.
Your data is encrypted with SQLCipher, with the key kept in your desktop keyring, or behind a passphrase if there is none.
Optional app lock with a 4–6 digit PIN.
Home: monthly income, spending and net, a 30-day spending chart, and breakdowns by category, merchant, month and weekday.
Activity: add, edit, search and filter transactions, with merchant, category, account and notes.
Accounts and transfers, weekly or monthly budgets per category, recurring bills and salary with reminders.
Loans per person and rotating savings circles, with partial repayments and a schedule.
Encrypted backups, automatic daily backups, and CSV import and export.
Sync with your phone or another computer over your local network.
Full Arabic interface, right to left.

description.p: Voice entry, available in the other Linux downloads, isn't included in this version.

screenshot.caption: Home: monthly totals, a 30-day spending chart, and spending by category and by merchant
Income vs spending over 6 months, this month against last, and spending by weekday
Savings circles: where you stand in each, and the next payment

description.p: Savings circles (جمعيات): payment, participants, schedule, payout and where you stand. Live countdowns to the next reminder. Accounts and transfers, loans, CSV import and export, 69 currencies, and the full interface in Arabic.
Accounts with balances and transfers between them, loans per person, CSV import and export, merchants, and a configurable Home layout.
Sync between your devices over your local network, and reminders for recurring items, loans and savings circles.
